item.title: Crash closes part of I-69 in Fishers
item.description: FISHERS, Ind. – A crash closed part of I-69 in Fishers. It happened around 7 a.m. on I-69 southbound at mile marker 205 near 116th Street. All southbound lanes were closed. Indiana Department of Transportation cameras showed emergency personnel at the scene. An alert indicated the crash involved an injury. This is a developing story.
